dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Honorary Senior Researcher, how wonderful to see you. I'm organizing these files and folders in accordance with Monsieur Raimondo's instructions.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: This part of the archive wasn't so badly hit by the explosion and is still structurally sound, so the files are in good shape.

dialogues.speaker: Chalmet
dialogues.text: Although I'm not sure how useful they are now... But we should at least get them properly filed first.
